errors-50-reviewed.method: Read all 50 line, neighbor and source-node disagreements. Visually checked d01-07 PDF pages 14 and 34. Other semantic judgments remain provisional; no human gold labels. No labels or model parameters changed.
errors-50-reviewed.selection: 25 false positives and 25 false negatives against silver; seed 42, round-robin books, at most 5/book, alternate numbered status when available, prioritize largest score disagreement. Not a random accuracy estimate.
